author: Lebanon PA News
title: Senator Chris Gebhard highlights community achievements and upcoming seminar in recent tweets
text:
State Senator Chris Gebhard | Pennsylvania
State Senator Chris Gebhard | Pennsylvania
Senator Chris Gebhard, who represents Pennsylvania's 48th Senatorial District, has recently highlighted several community events and achievements through his social media posts.
On July 28, 2025, Gebhard shared a message celebrating positive news in the local area. He wrote, "This is the kind of uplifting news we all need—and it happened right here in our community. Well done to everyone involved in making wishes come true! Check out the full story from abc27 News https://t.co/OpE6qvmYN6".
The following day, on July 29, 2025, Gebhard extended an invitation to a public seminar on firearm laws. In his post he stated, " You're invited! Join Rep. Jamie Barton & me for a Concealed Carry Seminar on Sept. 25, 6–8 PM at Cabela’s in Hamburg. Learn about PA's carry laws, the Castle Doctrine & more from Berks Co. Sheriff Mandy Miller. RSVP: https://t.co/c5K4RF00qz https://t.co/p5j8RYkcHp".
On July 30, 2025, Gebhard congratulated local scholarship recipients with the message: "Congratulations to the Berks CDC Scholarship Recipients! Leah Walter – recipient of both the $1,000 John Scheuller Memorial Scholarship and the $2,000 Glenn Seidel Memorial Scholarship Lindsay Solomon – recipient of the $500 Berks County Conservation District Scholarship https://t.co/McvoWjkKbV".
Senator Chris Gebhard serves constituents in Lebanon County and parts of Dauphin and York counties as part of Pennsylvania's legislative body. His recent posts reflect ongoing efforts to engage with local residents through recognition of achievements and promotion of educational opportunities and public safety events.
